h1: Email automation for routine sending and sorting
overview: If you send the same emails or sort the same messages every day, a few rules can do it for you. We set up your inbox to label and forward incoming mail, send confirmations and follow-ups when something happens, and prepare draft replies for common questions. Messages follow anti-spam rules, include opt-out wording where needed and never go to people who did not ask.

faq: Which email systems can you automate?
Gmail and Google Workspace, Outlook and Microsoft 365, plus tools like Mailchimp or Klaviyo for marketing sends. We confirm your set-up before you order.
Will emails go out without my review?
Only the ones you choose. Draft replies are saved for you to approve by default. Confirmations and reminders can go automatically once you are happy with the wording.
Is this the same as email marketing?
No. This is for routine, one-to-one or transactional messages. Marketing campaigns are a separate service, and bulk or cold sending is not part of this.
We follow anti-spam laws and platform rules: honest sender details, opt-out links where required, and sending only to people who have a relationship with you.
